$comment: CANONICAL PRQ mode weights. Swift, Python and TypeScript all read THIS file.
Before this file existed there were two tables that had silently diverged:
Five modes disagreed, so the same session earned a different PRQ delta
depending on which platform scored it — who_scene_it by 57%.
Values are seeded from the SWIFT table, which is the more deliberate one:
it rates the cognitive modes at 1.1 because Brain Brawl and Who Scene It
carry the Mental Resiliency thesis, and the backend's 0.8/0.7 reads like a
placeholder nobody revisited. Changing them is a product call, so the
differences are listed under `migration` rather than buried.
tests/prq_weights_test.ts PARSES both real source files and fails if either
drifts from this one. Do not edit a language-specific table.

migration.$comment: What changes for a player, if this file is adopted as written. Every one of these RAISES the reward; none are nerfs.

notes.market_browse: 0.0 by design — the Module Library is a shop, not a scoring mode. It must never mint PRQ. The backend omitted it entirely, which meant it fell through to the 1.0 default: a shop visit was worth as much as a baseball game.
notes.unknown_modes: Fall back to `default` (1.0). Never throw — an unrecognised mode must still score, or a new mode silently pays nothing.
